quotes: "Very professional. That's the kind of presentation we expect."
"Looking sharp! You've made a great first impression."
"You could have made a little more effort to look professional."
"Love the originality! You clearly have a creative eye."
"Interesting work! I can see you've been involved in some exciting projects. But I'm curious, what would you say was your biggest contribution to these projects?"
"That's bold thinking! You've got real creative potential."
"Wonderful! Every production needs someone who keeps the team organised."
"A natural team leader! I can see you leading a project someday."
"That's great! You seem really good at keeping everyone on the same page."
"Impressive! You really know your way around the industry."
"Just one more question before we wrap up. You know, the creative industry can be pretty demanding, especially when we're working on tight deadlines. So, do you have any plans to start a family?"
"Good to hear! We've got some exciting projects coming up."
"Of course, things can change. We're just hoping to find someone who can stay with us for the long term."
"That's reassuring! Things can get pretty hectic around here."
"Of course, we just want to make sure everyone can manage their responsibilities in the long run."
"Of course. We just like to get to know our team a little better."
"Anyway, I think we've covered everything for today. We'll be in touch soon."
"Just one more question before we wrap up. You know, the creative industry can be pretty demanding, especially when we're working on tight deadlines. How do you feel about working late sometimes?"
"Fair enough! It's important to have a life outside work. Of course, things don't always go according to schedule in this industry."
"Love the attitude! You sound like someone we can really count on."
"Congratulations! You've made it to the final stage of our recruitment process. We'd like to invite you to join us for an unpaid one-week trial!"
"Great job, everyone! You've all done really well this week. We're impressed by your hard work and creativity!"
"We'll review your performances and let you know the results soon."
"Congratulations! We're pleased to offer you the Junior Producer position. We were impressed by your creative potential and look forward to seeing what you'll bring to the team!"

"Congratulations! We were impressed by your performance during the trial, particularly your strong communication and organisational skills. We believe you'd be a better fit for the Production Coordinator role and would like to offer you this position instead."

"Thank you for your time and effort throughout the recruitment process. Unfortunately, we regret to inform you that you have not been selected for the position. We appreciate your interest and wish you all the best in your future career."
"That audience angle is the one I just suggested. I can walk everyone through it."
"Let's not get territorial. It's a team idea."
"Sophie raised this point first. She should take us through it."
"They're our colleagues, not something for you to rate by their bodies."
"This isn't an appropriate way to talk about team members. Let's get back to the project."
"Why are you leading the way in rating the women in this company?"
"Got a minute to talk about your tone last night?"
"You were there last night. Did you hear it?"
"Very capable, but needs to work on collaboration."
"Everything's fine at home. Shall we talk about the project?"
"Good to hear. Though this project runs for at least three years. You two have been together a while now... nothing's going to change in the next three years, is it?"
"To be honest, we're thinking about having a baby next year."
"Let's revisit once things have settled down for you."
"Oh, congratulations in advance! That's usually when people really step up."
"Don't worry, nothing's going to change at home any time soon. It won't affect my work."
"Ha, you don't need to promise me that. Things change at home, that's normal. The job's yours."
"Someone has to look after things at home, and you earn more than me anyway."
"Why not get your wife to help? Seems like a waste of money."
"All right, since you've asked, I'll have a word with the channel."
"Hm. I'd have thought you'd have the most time. You're the only one here without kids, after all."
"Can't you tell them you'll do it in the morning?"
"Next time, better if you're in the room."
"But I've arranged to talk to that commissioner about next series..."
"Probably for the best. You'll have more time for things at home."
"Are you sure? Chances like this don't come along often."
"Leave? But haven't you always had someone at home holding things together?"
"Great team player, super organised, always happy to help."
"Bold, a bit chaotic, but a real creative."
"Good approach. Let's hire like this from now on."
"grab a drink, just us, and talk about your future"
"I didn't know who to go to. Everyone says you're nice."
"We've all been through it. Grit your teeth and get the permanent role first."
"Daniel just doesn't think before he speaks. He doesn't mean anything by it. Don't take it to heart."
"Low cost, quick results, and it keeps the clients happy."
"This is mainly to help the women with kids, isn't it?"
"Of course we all support diversity. The question is, what will this cost the company?"
"Let's hope this doesn't look like special treatment."
"I'll help you push it next year."
"I thought today was just a formality."
“非常专业，这正是我们期待的形象。”
“很精神！你给人的第一印象很棒。”
“太有个性了！你显然很有创意眼光。”
“作品很有意思！看得出你参与过一些很棒的项目。不过我很好奇，你觉得自己在这些项目里最大的贡献是什么？”
“很大胆的想法！你真的很有创意潜力。”
“太好了！每个制作团队都需要一个让大家井井有条的人。”
“天生的团队领导者！我能想象你将来带领一个项目。”
“很棒！你看起来很擅长让所有人保持同步。”
“厉害！你对这个行业真的很熟悉。”
“结束前最后一个问题。你知道，创意行业的工作强度很大，尤其是赶截止日期的时候。所以，你有成家生孩子的打算吗？”
“那就好！我们接下来有一些很棒的项目。”
“当然，计划总会变。我们只是希望找到一个能长期留下来的人。”
“那我就放心了！这里有时候会很忙。”
“当然，我们只是想确保每个人都能长期兼顾好自己的责任。”
“当然。我们只是想多了解一下团队成员。”
“好了，我想今天就聊到这里。我们会尽快联系你。”
“结束前最后一个问题。你知道，创意行业的工作强度很大，尤其是赶截止日期的时候。你对偶尔加班怎么看？”
“有道理！工作之外有自己的生活很重要。当然，这个行业的事情不总是按计划来。”
“就喜欢这种态度！听起来你是我们可以真正依靠的人。”
“恭喜！你已进入招聘的最后阶段。我们诚邀你参加为期一周的无薪试用！”
“大家干得好！这周你们都表现得很棒，你们的努力和创意让我们印象深刻！”
“我们会评估每个人的表现，尽快通知结果。”
“恭喜！我们很高兴向你发出初级制片人职位的录用通知。你的创意潜力让我们印象深刻，期待看到你为团队带来的新东西！”
“恭喜！你在试用期间的表现让我们印象深刻，尤其是你出色的沟通和组织能力。我们认为你更适合制作协调（Production Coordinator）的岗位，希望改为向你发出这个职位的录用通知。”
“感谢你在整个招聘过程中付出的时间和努力。很遗憾地通知你，你未能获得该职位。感谢你对我们的关注，祝你今后的职业发展一切顺利。”
“这个受众切入点是我刚才提出的，我可以带大家完整讲一遍。”
“别这么计较归属，这是团队的点子。”
“Sophie 刚才先提出了这个观点，应该由她来为大家说明。”
“她们是我们的同事，不是让你们按身材打分的对象。”
“这样议论团队成员并不合适，我们回到项目吧。”
“为什么由你带头议论并给公司的女性员工打分？”
“有空聊一下你昨晚说话的态度吗？”
“你昨晚也在那里。你听见了吗？”
“能力很强，但需要提升合作能力。”
“家里都挺好的。我们聊聊这个项目吧？”
“那就好。不过这个项目至少要跟三年，你们俩在一起这么久了，这三年里……不会有什么变动吧？”
“说实话，我们在考虑明年要个孩子。”
“等你那边稳定下来，我们再考虑。”
“哦，那先恭喜啦！人往往就是在这时候真正担起事来的。”
“您放心，近期家里不会有什么变动，不会影响工作。”
“哈哈，不用跟我保证这个，家里有变化很正常。职位是你的了。”
“总得有人照护家里，而且你赚得也比我多。”
“这么快就回去上班了？真勇敢。”
“为什么不让你的妻子帮忙呢？这钱花得真不值。”
“行，既然你开口了，我去跟台里说说。”
“嗯。我还以为你是最有时间的那个呢，毕竟你是我们这儿唯一没有小孩的。”
“你就不能跟他们说明早再弄吗？”
“他们特别喜欢你那个档案纪录片的点子。”
“可是我跟那位编辑约好了要聊下一季……”
“他们特别喜欢你那个档案纪录片的点子。”
“也好，这样你也能多顾着点家里。”
“真的不考虑一下？这种机会可不常有。”
“离开？可你家里不是一直有人帮你顶着吗？”
“团队合作能力强，做事超级有条理，总是乐于帮忙。”
“大胆，有点乱，但是个真正的创意人。”
“这个做法好，以后招聘我们都这么办。”
“我不知道该找谁。大家都说你人很好。”
“大家都是这么过来的。忍一忍，先把转正拿下。”
“Daniel 就是嘴上没把门，没什么恶意，别太往心里去。”
“成本低，见效快，客户那边也好交代。”
“这主要是为了照顾有孩子的女同事吧？”
“我们当然都支持多元化。问题是，这件事对公司来说，成本是多少？”
“希望这不会让外界觉得我们在搞特殊照顾。”
“团队合作能力强，做事超级有条理”
"Of course, plans change. If anything does, make sure I'm the first to know."
"That's valuable experience. It'll come in handy when it's your turn."
"Didn't I just say? It's only temporary."
"From a risk management point of view, that makes sense."
"We'll approve one year of budget and review the results next year."
"Fair point. A statement alone isn't enough."
"Sorry, I think I need to take some time off."
“我们重视每一位员工的声音。”
“当然，计划总赶不上变化，有变化记得第一个告诉我。”
“这可是宝贵的经验，等轮到你的时候会派上用场的。”
“我刚才不是说了吗，只是临时的。”
“从风险管理的角度，这个说得通。”
“预算先批一年，明年看效果再说。”
“对不起，我可能需要休息一段时间。”
